svg.desc: Runtime modules within the Praetor binary, daemon services, and configuration inputs.

g.text: Reads .agents/ personas and skills (agents.go persona projection).
LoadCascadingRunnerConfigContext starts from DefaultRunnerPolicy and merges .config/fleet.yaml onto it.
Then the runners: key of .standards.yaml overrides fleet and org; the last layer merged wins.
Canary test wraps failure in SARIF.
Distills summary and writes full report.
